subject: Model averaging and psi prediction at t+1

messages.author: 62deb92fef01162b
messages.subject: Model averaging and psi prediction at t+1
parts:
Hello everybody, 

I am using a model averaging in dynamic occuancy models. I used the modavgPred function to get the prediction of psi for the first year. 

I am struggling to get t+1 predictions for psi parameter. 
I can't find the equivalent of smoothed() and @projected when using a model averaging/list of models. 

Do you have an idea ? 

Best, 

Yaelle

messages.author: 4e956cc50ac3e075
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Model averaging and psi prediction at t+1
parts:
Bonjour Yaelle,

modavgPred( ) will work to get predictions of the parameters in your
model, but not derived parameters. In the case of the dynamic occupancy
model fit with colext( ), the parameters are the occupancy of the first
season, colonization between seasons, extinction between seasons, and
detection probability on each visit. If you want to get model-averaged
predictions for derived parameters (e.g., occupancy in t+1), then you
will need to get the estimates (either by hand or smoothed) from each
model, and then plug them in the modavgCustom( ) function. See
?modavgCustom for a few examples of using the function.

Best,

Marc
